# Vulkan headers

Unmodified C headers from KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers, tag **v1.3.290**:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.3.290

This subset contains `include/vulkan/*.h`, `include/vk_video/*.h`, the upstream
license summary and both license texts. C++ wrapper headers and SDK tools are
not needed by TrayTemps. Bundling these headers lets a normal Visual Studio
solution build compile the limiter without installing a separate Vulkan SDK.

See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) and [LICENSES](LICENSES).
